description: Look-alike text with nothing sensitive in it. Every detection is a false positive. The `name-words` cases (2026-09-20) use words that are also names in their ordinary sense (will, rose, mark, pierre, blanc, rosa, pilar…); they measure the over-redaction the NER fine-tune risks once the model learns lowercase and bare first names. Written while fixing the rule gaps found by the real-document sets (2026-09-18): years before capitalised words, version numbers shaped like dates, weights in pounds, empty form labels, year ranges, table columns padded with spaces. No person, company or place names on purpose.
